ns2:course.label: Workplace Dispute Resolution
ns2:course.description: Examination of the use of procedures to resolve employment disputes in both union and nonunion workplaces; comparative analysis of grievance arbitration, interest arbitration, mediation, fact-finding, and combinations of these procedures; special emphasis given to the role of third party intervention. Same as ECON 543 and LAW 665. 3 professional hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Human Res & Industrial Rels major(s).
